Purpose and scope This policy explains how every ABC Corp employee, contractor and intern must protect company information and IT systems. It applies to all company devices and to any personal device used to access company email or systems. Breaking this policy may lead to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment or contract. 2. Passwords Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include upper-case letters, lower-case letters, numbers and a symbol. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. You cannot reuse

at least 12 characters long and include upper-case letters, lower-case letters, numbers and a symbol. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. You cannot reuse any of your last 5 passwords. Never share your password with anyone, including IT staff. The IT Helpdesk will never ask for your password by phone, chat or email. Using a password manager approved by IT (ABC Vault) is strongly recommended. 3. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) MFA is mandatory for all employees for email, VPN and all cloud applications. Use the Microsoft Authenticator app on your phone. If you change or lose your phone, contact the IT Helpdesk on extension 4357 before your old phone is reset, so your MFA can be moved. 4. lose your phone, contact the IT Helpdesk on extension 4357 before your old phone is reset, so your MFA can be moved. 4. Locking your device Lock your screen whenever you leave your desk (Windows key + L). Company laptops lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity. Never leave a laptop unattended in a public place such as a cafe, train or airport.

Data classification All company information belongs to one of four classes: Public (can be shared outside the company), Internal (for employees only), Confidential (only for people who need it for their work) and Restricted (highest protection, such as customer personal data and financial results before publication). Confidential and Restricted information must not be sent to personal email accounts, uploaded to personal cloud storage, or entered into public AI tools such as free online chatbots. Restricted information must be encrypted when sent outside the company. 6. Email and phishing Be suspicious of unexpected emails asking you to click a link, open an attachment, pay

encrypted when sent outside the company. 6. Email and phishing Be suspicious of unexpected emails asking you to click a link, open an attachment, pay an invoice or enter your password. Report suspicious emails with the "Report Phishing" button in Outlook. Do not forward them to colleagues. If you clicked a link or entered your password on a suspicious page, call the IT Helpdesk on extension 4357 immediately, even outside office hours. 7. USB drives and removable media USB storage devices are blocked on all company laptops. Use OneDrive or SharePoint to share files. If you have a business need for a USB device (for example, a client presentation at an external venue), request an exception on the IT Portal.

you have a business need for a USB device (for example, a client presentation at an external venue), request an exception on the IT Portal. Exceptions are valid for a maximum of 30 days. 8. Reporting security incidents Report any security incident within 1 hour of noticing it. Examples: a lost or stolen device, a virus warning, a suspicious login alert, or data sent to the wrong person. Report by calling extension 4357 or emailing security@abccorp.example. You will not be punished for reporting an honest mistake quickly; late reporting makes the damage worse.

Standard equipment Every employee receives one standard company laptop. Office staff receive a 14-inch business laptop; engineering and design staff may request a high-performance model with manager approval. All laptops are configured by IT with encryption, antivirus and automatic updates. Do not disable these protections. 2. Laptop replacement Laptops are replaced every 4 years. IT will contact you about 1 month before your replacement date. A laptop may be replaced earlier if it is damaged or no longer works properly. Raise a Hardware Request on

month before your replacement date. A laptop may be replaced earlier if it is damaged or no longer works properly. Raise a Hardware Request on the IT Portal. Before handing in an old laptop, make sure all your files are saved to OneDrive. IT erases all data from returned laptops. 3. Lost or stolen equipment Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the IT Helpdesk (extension 4357) as soon as possible and in any case within 24 hours. IT will lock and erase the device remotely. If the device was stolen, you must also file a police report and send the report number to IT. The first replacement is free of charge. Repeated losses caused by carelessness may
also file a police report and send the report number to IT. The first replacement is free of charge. Repeated losses caused by carelessness may be charged to your department.

Accessories for home and office Employees may order accessories such as an external monitor, keyboard, mouse or headset through the IT Portal. The accessory budget is up to JPY 30,000 per employee every 3 years. Items above this amount need manager approval. 5. Personal use Limited personal use of company equipment (for example, checking the news during a break) is allowed, as long as it does not affect your work and follows the IT Security Policy. Do not install games, personal software or browser extensions. All software must be requested through the IT Portal. 6. Leaving the company When you leave ABC Corp,

install games, personal software or browser extensions. All software must be requested through the IT Portal. 6. Leaving the company When you leave ABC Corp, you must return your laptop, phone, security badge and all accessories within 5 working days of your last day. Equipment that is not returned will be charged at its current value.

Who can work remotely Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with their manager's approval. New employees must work from the office for their first 4 weeks. Remote work arrangements are recorded in the HR system by your manager. 2. Connecting to the VPN The VPN (ABC Connect) is required to access internal systems such as the IT Portal, file shares and the finance system from outside the office. To connect: open the ABC Connect app, sign in with your work

the IT Portal, file shares and the finance system from outside the office. To connect: open the ABC Connect app, sign in with your work email, and approve the request in the Microsoft Authenticator app on your phone. The VPN disconnects automatically after 12 hours. Reconnect if needed. 3. VPN troubleshooting If the VPN does not connect: (1) check that your internet connection works by opening a public website; (2) restart the ABC Connect app; (3) restart your laptop; (4) make sure the Authenticator app on your phone has notifications enabled. If it still fails, raise a ticket on the IT Portal from another device, or call extension 4357. Include a screenshot of the error message.

ABC Corp - DUMMY document created for an AI demo. Not a real policy. Page 2 4. Home working setup Your home internet connection should provide at least 20 Mbps download speed for video calls. Use a private, password-protected home Wi-Fi network. Change the default password on your home router. Do not let family members or visitors use your company laptop. 5. Public Wi-Fi and working in public places Public Wi-Fi (cafes, hotels, airports) may only be used with the VPN connected at all times. Do not discuss Confidential or Restricted information in public places where you can be overheard, and use a privacy screen filter when working on trains or in cafes. Privacy filters can be requested from IT

where you can be overheard, and use a privacy screen filter when working on trains or in cafes. Privacy filters can be requested from IT free of charge. 6. Printing at home Printing Confidential or Restricted documents at home is not allowed. Internal documents may be printed at home only if they are shredded after use. 7. Working from another country Working from outside Japan requires approval from your manager, HR and IT at least 2 weeks in advance, because of tax, legal and security rules. Some countries block VPN connections. IT will confirm whether the VPN can be used in your destination before approval.
